reviewer_description: Presenter alone on blank canvas; a news-site article screenshot (red banner, headline) builds in over 12 frames from a thin sliver at left to the full page at centre-left while the presenter's pointer lifts to point at it.

Article screenshot scrolls upward (headline exits top, bullet list and a green line chart 'Surplus of Sellers' enter bottom); red handwritten '58%' appears at upper right mid-motion; presenter static.
Second scroll-up step: bullets leave top, the green chart rises and enlarges toward centre-left; '58%' label and presenter stay fixed.
Short final scroll-up step settles the chart header and chart at upper-centre with paragraph text below; label and presenter fixed.
A small doodle house and a grey office-building icon appear together at lower left over the article text; nothing else changes.

Whole composition zooms in about 1.3x (chart larger, presenter larger and smiling, pointer repositioned) while a green country-shaped blob with a face enters at top-left and more building icons appear bottom-left.
Tiny change at lower right near presenter's hand: a small red mark/pointer tip shifts as the pointer lowers; rest static.
Green blob and house/building icons at left exit; '58%' label jumps up off the top edge and returns; presenter slides lower-centre and face changes from smile to frown; chart enlarges.
A red double-headed vertical arrow appears at right edge beside the chart end (x~0.93, y~0.45-0.65).
A small red diagonal arrow pointing down-left appears at upper left of the chart (x~0.05, y~0.3).
Tiny change near the chart's right end, where a small cursor/data-tag mark flickers for two frames; red arrows unchanged.

Presenter jumps from large centre position with frown to smaller right position with flat neutral face and pointer; both red arrows vanish; chart re-laid out slightly and an orange highlight bar appears at top text.
A tiny cursor and small data tooltip (year and percent) appears at left start of the green chart line (x~0.05, y~0.3).
A coloured doodle house (red roof, trees) appears above the chart at upper centre-right, and the orange text highlight lengthens by a few words.
A second small character (bald, tan face, green tie, holding a green dollar bill) pops in at lower left over the chart; orange highlight extends further.
Whole screenshot scene and all props replaced by blank white canvas with a single standing stick figure, arms bent, neutral raised-eyebrow face, at centre.

Blank canvas presenter shrinks and smiles, dollar sign, house and office-block icons pop at upper right, a red zig-zag arrow strokes down across the frame, then a bald tan figure with green tie beside a for-sale house replaces them.
Happy bald tan figure with green tie and the for-sale house are replaced by a single hooded figure with dark sunglasses holding green banknotes, standing centre on blank canvas.

Single sunglasses figure replaced by a diagram: label 'Sellers' over a row of six small green-tied figures at left, label 'Buyers' above one tiny buyer figure, and a house with a yellow '$$$' price tag at right.
Yellow price tag on the house changes its red text from '$$$' to '$20' at upper right.
Sellers/Buyers diagram, house and price tag all removed; presenter alone on blank canvas with raised-eyebrow face.
Small presenter replaced by a much larger presenter close-up at left, a big doodle house at right, and a tiny stick figure leaping in between at lower centre.
The tiny stick figure below-left of the house changes limb pose (arms/legs reposition) while the large presenter and house stay.
Drawn scene (large presenter, house, tiny figure) replaced by a blue-header association web page screenshot with headline and an infographic thumbnail at right.
Article screenshot scrolls upward; headline and infographic leave top, section headings and bullet lists enter from bottom and layout slightly enlarges.
Page continues scrolling up while magnifying, so National Snapshot bullets grow to large readable text, filling frame width.
A surprised presenter with open mouth and hand to chin appears at right edge over the text page; text already carries a yellow highlight line.
Text page and presenter replaced by another web page with a red logo header, small paragraph, mint-green line chart and body text; one yellow highlighted word at top right.
Yellow highlight grows across the top paragraph (second line fills in) and a cursor drifts near the chart end at right; chart otherwise static.
Very small change near the chart's end label at upper right (cursor or data tag); highlighted lines unchanged.
A text snippet card with yellow/orange highlighted lines slides over the middle of the chart while a worried presenter rises into lower right; chart partially hidden.
Web page with overlay and worried presenter replaced by blank canvas: bespectacled man with red tie holding a white blank board with a red dot, centre-right.
The small red dot on the white board is replaced by hand-lettered black caps 'REASONS' at the board centre; figure and board outline unchanged.
A red hand-drawn X (two crossing strokes) is struck across the word 'REASONS' on the board.
Glasses man with crossed-out board replaced by a smiling presenter at left with pointer and a news article screenshot (red logo, headline, bullets) at right.
A red rectangle outline is drawn around the article headline at upper right while the presenter's pointer swings up to it; article static.
Article and presenter replaced by a bar-chart slide: bold two-line title, 'Housing Deficit' year axis, house and apartment icons at lower left, blue badge and small house at lower right, no bars yet.
First blue bar (2019, labelled 3.8M) grows upward from the axis line under the year '2019' over 6 frames.
Four more darker-blue bars (2021 4.3M, 2022 4.5M, 2023 4.7M, 2024 4.7M) grow in sequence left to right under the axis.
Bar-chart slide replaced by blank canvas with one large green dollar sign at left.
A second green dollar sign appears to the right of the first.
A third green dollar sign appears to the right.
A fourth green dollar sign appears to the right.
A fifth green dollar sign appears to the right.
Five dollar signs replaced by a two-line chart (red and cyan lines, title 'Number of Sellers Jumps to 6-Year High'); presenter's head with arms slides in from the left edge and settles at lower left.
A cluster of three red-roofed doodle houses pops into the upper right over the chart with a quick scale-up.
A second cluster of houses pops in at lower centre-left over the chart's falling line.
A single house pops in at lower right near the end of the chart lines.
A tiny grey-hooded figure with glasses pops in at lower centre-right over the chart lines near the buyers line.
Chart with house clusters and head replaced by a smiling presenter at left with pointer and a green chalkboard reading 'Still NOT cheap' at right.
Presenter's mouth changes from smile to frown and pointer raises toward the board; board unchanged.
Presenter and chalkboard replaced by a stack of papers labelled 'MORTGAGE' in red at left on blank canvas.
First dark-mode news-card (headline, thumbnail at right) appears at upper right of the mortgage papers.
Second dark news-card overlaps the first, offset down and right.
Third dark news-card appears below-left, overlapping the stack.
Fourth dark news-card appears at lower right of the stack.
Fifth dark news-card appears at the bottom of the stack.
Mortgage papers and cards replaced by blank canvas: handwritten 'In theory...' at top-left, orange percent coin, and a green zig-zag upward arrow drawn on after the cut.
Red zig-zag arrow draws on downward from upper centre to lower right while a green dollar sign drops from upper right to the arrow's end.
Hard cut to an iceberg illustration over sea (tip above water), then the view pans down past the waterline to the submerged blue ice mass filling the frame.
Underwater iceberg full-bleed image replaced by a blank canvas with one weathered brown house with red roof at centre.
A row of seven tiny houses slides in from the right edge and settles at right of the big house in two groups.
House row replaced by a presenter at left with pointer and a green chalkboard at right reading 'How tf did this happen???'.
Presenter and board replaced by a curly grey-haired character scratching head beside a small blue house at left; character shifts slightly over following frames.
Tiny small-print text appears at the lower right of the frame under the character.
Character and small blue house replaced by a government web page (nav bar, light-blue panel headline, photo of an older couple) that slides/scrolls into place.
A red rectangle outline appears around the agency logo at top-left of the page.
Red handwritten '4 in 10' appears at upper right of the page.
A paper stack labelled MORTGAGE appears right of the page below the '4 in 10' text; headline gets yellow highlight.
A red X is drawn across the mortgage papers.
Page, text and crossed papers replaced by a small calendar-and-paper icon marked DEBT on blank canvas.
A second DEBT calendar icon pops in right of the first.
A third DEBT calendar-and-paper icon appears at the right of the pair.
A fourth DEBT calendar-and-paper icon appears at the right end of the row.
Row of four DEBT icons replaced by one grey columned bank building with two round door handles at centre-left.
A speech bubble with handwritten 'Where's my money?!' appears at upper right of the bank building.
Bank and speech bubble replaced by a small blue house with trees at left and a brown-haired character with hand at chin at right.
The character's pose changes from hand-at-chin to one arm swinging out, mouth shifts; house unchanged.
Blue house and brown-haired figure replaced by a dark-haired bow-tie character with hand at chin at left and a large red-roofed house at right.
Bow-tie character and house replaced by a smiling presenter with pointer at left and an empty green chalkboard at right.
White chalk lettering 'Rate lock' appears on the board; presenter's mouth becomes a frown and pointer lifts to the board.
Board scene replaced by a close-up laughing presenter at left while a dark video-channel page with two thumbnail cards slides in from the right edge.
The presenter's open laughing mouth changes shape (smaller red mouth) at left; channel page static.
A tiny line of caption text fades in below the video thumbnails at the lower right.
Presenter and video-channel page replaced by a full-width government monetary-policy report web page (dark banner, left menu, body text).
Report page zooms in and scrolls down to a body-text column with a figure; presenter head rises in at lower left and a yellow highlight appears on a line.
Zoomed report page and presenter replaced by a full-bleed light-blue-framed line chart of a fixed-rate series.
A thin vertical hover line with a small date-value tooltip moves along the chart from left of centre to the low point, then right.
The hover-line tooltip jumps to a new position and its date/value text changes slightly on the chart's low area.
Chart replaced by a for-sale house with red sign at left and a grey-haired character in purple tie at right.
House and character replaced by a MORTGAGE paper stack at centre-left and a grey bank building at upper right.
The MORTGAGE paper stack shrinks and slides up and to the right until it sits against the bank's left side.
A second paper stack separates from the bank and grows as it drops to lower centre while the small paper stays by the bank.
A highlighted text snippet (orange/yellow lines) grows in at top-left from a tiny spot to full width.
Papers, bank and snippet replaced by a headband-wearing smiling character at left and a grey office tower at right.
Headband character and tower replaced by a red armchair with a person reclined in it, centre.
Armchair replaced by blank canvas; a circular agency seal with a house emblem slides in from the right edge and settles at right.
A small teal-outlined house emblem plus the word-mark of the first lending company appears at upper left, left of the circular agency seal which stays put on the right.
A second company logo (green roof glyph, large teal/green word-mark) pops in at lower left under the first logo; a tiny handwritten caption also appears at lower right under the seal.
Seal and both logos are replaced in one frame by a full-frame stacked area chart (grey, black, blue bands rising left to right) with a legend and source note.
A green cartoon map character with worried eyes slides in from the left edge and settles at lower left, overlapping the chart's y-axis labels.
The green map character slides back out to the left edge, uncovering the chart's y-axis labels again.
The grey and black bands of the chart are replaced by a tiled pattern of green money-bag doodles with dollar signs; the blue band and axes stay.
A smiling beige-faced stick-figure head with a raised arm appears at lower right, overlapping the chart's right edge.
Chart, money-bag pattern and presenter are replaced by a small full-page web screenshot of a government housing site (blue header bar, working-paper article) on white.
The small web page enlarges (scales up and crops) until the paper title and abstract fill the frame, and the presenter figure appears at left by the end.
From the enlarged view with presenter, a hard return to the small page header, then the page scales up again to a medium zoom on the title and abstract with a dark rule on top; presenter gone.
A doodle cluster (small house, grey tower block, red for-sale sign) appears at left over the abstract text.
A second house/tower/for-sale-sign cluster appears to the right of the first, over the abstract text.
A third house/tower/for-sale-sign cluster appears at far right, giving three clusters across the abstract.
The three property clusters fade out (ghosted mid-frames) while an orange percent-sign badge appears upper left and a green rising arrow draws in at lower left.
The paper screenshot is removed in one frame, leaving only the orange percent badge and green arrow on blank white; arrow tip shape also changes slightly.
The upper-right end of the green arrow extends by a short stroke (net change only at the arrow tip).
An arrowhead is drawn at the upper-right tip of the green arrow, completing the arrow.
A weathered olive-brown house doodle appears at lower right of the arrow and badge composition.
A small handwritten word appears to the left of the brown house at lower right, like an exclamation.
Percent badge, arrow, house and handwritten word are replaced by a small full-page screenshot of the government housing paper page.
The small page enlarges and crops into the abstract text; a smiling presenter figure rises in at lower right at the end.
The enlarged text with presenter is hard-cut back to the small full-page screenshot with blue header (same document, zoom reset).
The small page scales up again to a paragraph close-up, a yellow highlight appears on a phrase, and a house doodle slides up at lower right.
A small green money-bag doodle appears at lower left of the house over the document text.
A second tiny bag-like item appears beside the first and the yellow highlight in the text grows slightly longer.
The document jumps to a lower scroll position with a different yellow highlight; house and money bags are removed at lower right.
An orange percent-sign badge appears at lower centre below the text; a text highlight shifts slightly.
A black padlock appears at lower left of the percent badge; the yellow highlight in the text widens.
A worried stick figure holding a thin pointer appears right of the badge and padlock.
The worried stick figure is replaced by a green outlined dollar sign at right; more text is highlighted yellow at upper right.
A dollar sign frozen in a pale-blue ice block slides off to the right and exits, leaving the badge and padlock.
A grey-curly-haired stick figure scratching its head, plus a small blue house, appears at lower right where the dollar was.
A small handwritten speech bubble appears left of the grey-haired figure's head.
Grey-haired figure, house and bubble leave; a green dollar sign appears and a red jagged rising arrow draws up to the right.
Document, badge, padlock, arrow and dollar are replaced by a plain scene: green-tie stick figure at left and a cream house with red roof at right.
The figure's face changes from a flat expression to a smile; the house shifts slightly.
The house slides left behind the figure and disappears; the figure stays.
A speech bubble with a short handwritten refusal phrase appears upper right of the figure.
Figure and bubble are replaced by a full-frame news article screenshot with a red bar chart.
Three doodle buildings (pink house, tall tower, small blue house) slide in from the right edge; a cyan highlight also appears on a text line.
Article and doodle buildings are replaced by a large dark rounded phone shape with a white app icon, held by a thick black arm at lower left.
The white app icon on the phone screen shrinks to a point, leaving a blank grey screen.
The phone shape is replaced by a stick figure holding a small phone, flat mouth, with handwritten text beside the head.
The figure is cut to a much larger close-up with a wide open smile; the handwritten text beside the head changes to a different phrase.
The grinning close-up is replaced by the large dark phone shape again, with only a tiny dot on its screen.
The dot on the phone screen grows back into the white app icon.
The phone is replaced by a worried stick figure with teal tear dots and a wavy mouth, centred and smaller.
The worried figure is cut to a much larger close-up of the face (hard scale-up).
The close-up cuts back to a small figure with open arms and a gentle smile; tears gone, hair slightly different.
The figure is replaced by the green map character at lower left and a red zig-zag downward arrow that draws in from top left to lower right.
Map character and red arrow are replaced by an empty line chart (axes and price labels only) titled with a city metro price phrase.
A blue price line draws on from left to right across the chart, rising to a peak then declining.
A smiling stick figure holding a pointer appears at lower centre over the chart.
Chart and presenter are replaced by a yellow price-tag doodle with red dollar signs and a curved string.
The price tag changes to a torn version with a white rip across the middle.
The torn tag is replaced by a narrow portrait article screenshot (serif headline, city photo) at left.
The article page scrolls up and scales so the photo leaves the top and body text fills the frame, then a worried presenter appears at right.
An orange-yellow highlight appears on the first line of a sentence in the article body.
The highlight extends to the second line of the same sentence.
The highlight extends again to cover the last line of the sentence, completing a three-line highlight.
The article is removed and a smaller smiling stick figure stands alone at centre on blank white.
A cluster of eight small house and tower doodles (pink, grey, blue, brown mansion) appears above and around the figure.
The smiling figure is replaced by a small grey hooded figure with sunglasses holding cash, below the same house cluster.
A speech bubble with a short handwritten phrase appears right of the hooded figure.
The house cluster and hooded buyer are replaced by a green dollar sign and cream house at left, then a red zig-zag arrow draws down to the right.
Dollar, house and arrow are replaced by a wide city skyline photo with a tiny credit caption.
A handwritten place-name title appears above the photo.
The photo with its title slides right while the green map character enters from the left edge.
The map character's pupils change position (look sideways) at lower left.
A tiny handwritten remark appears above the map character's head.
Photo, title and map character are replaced by a single grey office-tower doodle at upper left on blank white.
A second tower doodle appears at right of the first.
A third tower doodle appears lower centre.
A fourth tower doodle appears upper centre between the others.
A fifth tower doodle appears at lower centre-right.
Five towers are replaced by a small real-estate site screenshot that zooms and scrolls into a ranked data table; a shocked presenter enters bottom right.
Table and presenter are replaced by an empty line-chart frame with a bold two-line title; a short line starts to appear at lower left.
A red handwritten '20%' label appears above the right end of the rising line.
The rising chart is replaced by a different line chart (jagged teal line falling over time) with a presenter holding a pointer at lower left.
A red-roofed mansion doodle with bushes appears at upper right over the chart.
The house's lower facade changes tint/pattern slightly (small localised change at the house base).
Chart, presenter and house are replaced by a dark news-headline card at top and the green map character at lower right.
The dark headline card swaps to a different outlet's headline and thumbnail; map character unchanged.
The headline card swaps again to another outlet's headline with a for-sale photo.
The headline card swaps to a third outlet's headline; same position and size.
The headline card swaps back to the earlier outlet's other headline (different text, smaller photo).
Card and map character are replaced by two side-by-side line charts with a smiling presenter in the middle.
The presenter exits and a cluster of three small house/tower doodles appears at lower left under the left chart.
A second cluster of three small building doodles appears to the right of the first.
An upside-down presenter head appears at top; the right chart's line turns thick cyan.
A red line draws over the left chart's line from left to right, tracing the rising wavy data.
Charts, clusters and head are replaced by blank white where a single green dollar sign bobs up and down, ending with a grey-haired figure beside a blue house.
The grey-haired figure and blue house are replaced by a ponytail-haired, tall worried stick figure at centre-left.
A hand-drawn wall clock appears to the right of the ponytail figure.
Measured as partial; actually the whole scene changes: large worried topknot figure and wall clock at right replaced by a small smiling topknot builder with raised hammer at centre-left.
Small hammer builder replaced by a large headband character at left and a small pink house at right.
Cream stack of mortgage papers with red title pops in at upper centre-right beside the pink house.
Headband character, document and house replaced by a small smiling spiky-haired stick figure at centre-left.
Measured partial; the spiky-haired figure is replaced entirely by a small worried topknot builder holding a hammer at left.
Pink LOAN document with red title appears at right of the builder.
Builder and LOAN document replaced by a full multi-line interest-rate chart screenshot.
A magenta horizontal line begins to draw across the left of the chart near the 12 level.
Magenta horizontal line continues extending rightward across the chart to the right edge of the plot.
Chart screenshot replaced by two teal houses with a red for-sale sign at left.
Two tiny stick builders with a saw, hammer and brick pile appear at right of the houses.
Houses and builders replaced by three oversized green banknotes held by black arms.
Banknotes and arms slide off to the right and down, leaving a blank canvas.
From blank canvas a green-tie buyer figure at left and a small red-roof cream house at right appear together.
The house slides left, passes the figure and exits; the figure's face changes from neutral to a smile.
Speech bubble with two lines of hand-lettered text appears upper right of the green-tie figure.
Measured partial; green-tie figure and bubble replaced by a small worried topknot builder at left.
Speech bubble with two lines of handwritten text appears right of the builder.
Builder and bubble replaced by a single-line time-series chart screenshot.
A thin vertical cursor line and small tooltip box appear near the right end of the chart line.
Tooltip and vertical hairline shift slightly right along the series.
Tooltip and hairline slowly track along the series' right end, moving right and upward.
Chart replaced by a small article-text screenshot with a presenter holding a pointer at lower right.
Article screenshot enlarges from small to filling the frame while the presenter stays at lower right.
Presenter's pointer arm changes: the pointer rises from a low line to a diagonal reaching up-left over the article text (checked on native crops).
Article and presenter replaced by a small worried topknot builder at left.
A large red armchair with a lounging figure appears at right of the builder.
Builder and armchair replaced by red word PRICES at left with an upright knife at right.
Knife turns from upright to horizontal at lower right and a white diagonal gap cuts through the word.
Cut word and knife replaced by a large blue company wordmark centred.
A yellow hard hat appears at upper left of the wordmark and a brown hammer at lower right.
Wordmark with hard hat replaced by a white investor-relations press-release web page (headline, date, bullet points).
A blue text-selection highlight sweeps across the small date line under the headline at left.
Selection reaches the last digit of the date; the text I-beam cursor shifts slightly at its end (native crop).
The mouse cursor at the end of the selected date changes from I-beam to an arrow and nudges.
A second web page screenshot with dark blue header appears over the right third of the press release, entering from the right edge.
A yellow highlighter bar appears over one sentence in the upper area of the right-hand statement page.
Both web pages replaced by a financial table document at right with a smiling presenter holding a pointer at bottom left.
The financial table zooms in, enlarging the lower rows (net earnings, per-share rows) to fill the frame while the presenter's pointer follows.
A blue text selection sweeps over the label of the boxed per-share row; red box already present.
The zoomed table disappears and a social-profile card (large wordmark, portrait photo, About text) rises in from the bottom to the right of the presenter.
Presenter and profile card replaced by a centred dark-mode transcript capture.
Dark transcript capture replaced by a large smiling presenter holding an open dictionary.
Large presenter with book replaced by a smaller neutral presenter at left and three building icons (pink house, tall tower, teal houses) at right.
Three yellow price tags with dollar amounts appear attached to the three buildings.
Presenter's lower left arm drops from a sharp bent raised pose to a lower hanging pose (native crop).
Tagged buildings vanish and the presenter becomes a smiling figure centred.
Presenter replaced by a dark transcript capture with a small house and grey tower icons at its lower right.
Transcript capture and icons replaced by a small blue wordmark at top-left on an otherwise blank canvas.
A green irregular land-plot blob appears low centre.
A green dollar sign appears above and right of the land blob.
A single green banknote appears beside the dollar sign.
A second banknote overlaps the first, making a small stack.
A third note is layered into the stack beside the dollar sign.
A bright green check mark appears at the right end of the land blob.
Dollar sign, banknote stack and check mark disappear, leaving the land blob.
A large red-roofed house with bushes appears on top of the land blob.
A small red for-sale sign appears at the right end of the land under the house.
A smiling spiky-haired stick figure appears left of the land and house.
Land, house, presenter and small logo replaced by a large wordmark with hard hat and hammer centred.
Wordmark replaced by an association web page (search bar, paragraph) at upper left and a smiling topknot builder with a hammer at right.
Web page and builder replaced by a spiky-haired presenter holding a pointer on a blank canvas.
A blue definition card slides in from the right edge across the right half of the frame.
Presenter's pointer arm shifts so the pointer swings up toward the blue card.
Presenter and blue card replaced by a trade-publication article screenshot at upper left and a smiling figure reading a newspaper at bottom.
Article and newspaper reader replaced by a navy company wordmark with script tagline centred.
A dark PDF-viewer screenshot with thumbnail strip grows from a narrow centre sliver to a wide panel filling the middle.
Right-hand page pane of the PDF viewer swaps to a different page of transcript text; thumbnails stay.
PDF page zooms in: thumbnail strip slides off left and the transcript page enlarges to fill the frame.
A spiky-haired presenter appears at the right edge beside the transcript page.
A red underline stroke extends rightward beneath a phrase in the upper left transcript (native crop).
The red underline continues, with a bracket-like turn under the next phrases (native crop).
No visible content change at the document's right edge near the presenter (native crop identical).
Transcript page and presenter replaced by a smiling presenter alone, centred.
Presenter shifts left, frowns and holds a pointer; a green chalkboard with large text appears at right.
Presenter and chalkboard replaced by a blog-article screenshot at left and a red-roof house with bushes at right.
A red handwritten negative dollar amount appears above the house at right.
Article, amount and house replaced by a two-line price chart with a small house icon inside the plot.
A second smaller dark-roofed house appears right of the small house on the chart.
Chart zooms in on its left/top section while a presenter with a pointer enters at right.
A short red hand-lettered word with exclamation appears near the chart's right edge by the pointer tip.
Zoomed chart and presenter replaced by a small green-tie figure alone at left-centre.
Green-tie figure's arms/pose change: right arm raised, mouth changes.
A red sports car appears at right of the figure.
A yellow price tag with a dollar amount appears above the car's front.
Scene pans rightward: figure and red car slide right and a blue small car with price tag enters from the left.
Cars and figure replaced by one large red-roof tan house with bushes centred.
The large house is replaced by a smaller simpler house with a single gable, same position.
House replaced by an article screenshot that scrolls up from below, showing the end of a chart and then body text.
Article text scrolls a few pixels upward and settles.
Three building icons (pink house, tower, teal houses) appear at lower right over the article text.
Article with highlights and icons replaced by a smiling presenter alone, arms out.
Measured partial; presenter replaced entirely by a worried topknot builder at left and a hooded figure with sunglasses holding cash at right.
A green dollar sign appears between the two figures.
The dollar sign is replaced by a pink loan document with red title.
Figures and document replaced by a social-profile card that rises from the bottom and enlarges to centre.
Profile card replaced by a dark transcript capture at top-left and a bespectacled figure at a laptop desk at lower right.
Transcript capture and laptop figure replaced by a blue wordmark at top centre on a blank canvas.
A first small standing figure (brown skin, blue tie, waving) appears centre.
A second figure (grey bob, purple tie) appears right of the first.
A third figure (curly brown hair) appears right of the second.
A small figure with a brown hat appears at far left of the trio.
Another figure with a reddish headband hat appears further left.
The two left figures disappear and a red handwritten word appears at left in their place.
Four-figure logo scene with small red word 'Nope' is replaced by a pale-blue definition card (centre-left) with a bent-over presenter head and shoulder peeking in from far left.
Blue definition card and peeking presenter replaced by big red outlined 'PRICES' lettering at centre-left with a vertical kitchen knife at upper right on white.
Knife jumps from vertical upper-right to a near-horizontal pose lower-right, and the 'PRICES' lettering now has a white gap sliced through it between 'PRI' and 'ES'.
Sliced 'PRICES' text and knife replaced by a blue wordmark at top-left and a small pink two-storey house with green bushes below it at centre-left.
A yellow price tag with red dollar signs, tied by a string, appears on the left of the pink house.
Text on the yellow tag shrinks from a triple-dollar mark to a single red dollar sign; tag outline unchanged.
A worried character with tousled brown hair, red headband and chin-on-hand pose appears at lower right, partly cropped by the bottom edge.
A tiny red handwritten caption (looks like 'still too broke') appears just left of the worried character's head.
House, tag and worried character replaced by a huge close-up of a black-haired character in the right half holding a green dollar bill at lower left.
A white speech bubble with handwritten black text appears at upper left of the close-up character (a question about what two dollars buys).
Close-up character with bubble replaced by the large blue wordmark centred on white with a small knife glued to its right end.
Small knife at the right end of the wordmark tilts upright, rises and shrinks away upward, then vanishes; wordmark stays.
Wordmark replaced by a scatter of four small houses, three grey apartment blocks and three red FOR SALE signs across centre.
House scatter replaced by two stick builders: left one with hand saw, right one blonde with hammer, and a stack of three orange bricks between them.
A large thick crimson X is drawn over the whole builders-and-bricks scene.
